en: The image shows a panoramic view of a coastal city with a large bay, several docks or piers, and a densely built cityscape with a mixture of mid-rise and low-rise buildings. The foreground features leafy greenery and rooftops, while the background extends into lush green hills. The photo has a hand-tinted or early colorized look, suggesting it is from the early-to-mid 20th century. There are no visible modern skyscrapers, and the architecture appears Mediterranean or colonial European.
